eod.description: When true, return the closed day's quote.

time_series.formatted.title: Get formatted time series
time_series.formatted.description: Return a bounded OHLCV window via GET /time_series. format selects JSON or CSV; outputsize bounds the window.

outputsize.description: Maximum bars.

timezone.description: Timezone for timestamps.

stocks.reference.title: List stocks reference
stocks.reference.description: List the stocks reference directory via GET /stocks, including format, MIC, and include_delisted.

exchange.description: Exchange filter.

symbol_search.query.title: Search symbols by query
symbol_search.query.description: Search instruments via GET /symbol_search. The query input is sent as the documented symbol parameter, and limit is sent as outputsize.

query.description: Ticker or instrument-name text. Sent as symbol.

includePlan.description: Include plan information. Sent as show_plan.
